description: This file contains implementations of the `gitbasename` and `gitdirname` functions, which are custom variants of path manipulation functions similar to standard basename() and dirname(). The functions include handling of DOS drive prefixes and POSIX path semantics, suggesting they are part of a compatibility or utility layer within a Git-related codebase.

methods.name: char * gitbasename(char * path)
methods.description: Returns the base name component of a given path, handling DOS drive prefixes and directory separators. Mimics the standard basename behavior with additional path handling.

methods.name: char * gitdirname(char * path)
methods.description: Returns the directory name component of a path, taking into account POSIX specifications, DOS drive prefixes, and ignoring trailing slashes. Similar to dirname() but with extra handling for Windows-style paths.
